definitions.latin: adv&o-short;c&a-long;tus, qui rei emptæ f&i-short;dem præstat

quotations.old_english: Ic wille ðæt gehwilc man hæbbe his geteáman
quotations.english: I will that every man have his warranter

source_text: ge-teáma, -týma, an; m. An advocate, avoucher, a warranter; adv&o-short;c&a-long;tus, qui rei emptæ f&i-short;dem præstat :-- Ic wille ðæt gehwilc man hæbbe his geteáman I will that every man have his warranter, L. Ed. 1; Th. i. 158, 9: L. Eth. ii. 8; Th. i. 288, 16. v. teám, ge-téman.
